development_decision.authorization: development evidence only; freeze a disjoint prospective protocol before candidate construction or any Arena action

rules.fixed: non-recipe6 best fixed; positive map-balanced delta; worst opponent delta >= -5; training completion >= 95%
rules.selector: map oracle gain >= 5; at least two recipes win >=2 maps; gain among training-complete pairs >= 5

scope: paired exact-engine D11 fixed-recipe development catalog; map seed is the primary independent unit; reused local maps; not Arena-calibrated
